UGO Fellowship Program Details

The Universal Greening Organization (UGO) Fellowship Program is a flagship youth empowerment initiative that bridges the gap between academic knowledge and real-world environmental action.

Rooted in the belief that Africa’s sustainable development must be led by Africans themselves, the fellowship provides a platform for students and graduates to gain hands-on experience, professional exposure, and cross-cultural collaboration opportunities.

Over a 90-day intensive program, fellows participate in six learning modules that combine leadership, sustainability, innovation, and diplomacy.

Following the training phase, fellows take part in an international exchange program hosted in partner countries such as Kenya, Botswana, and Sierra Leone.

This experience allows them to engage with universities, policymakers, and grassroots innovators while fostering Pan-African collaboration and cultural appreciation.

UGO Fellowship Program Requirements

To be eligible for the UGO Fellowship Program 2026, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Applicants must be citizens of Botswana, Burundi, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, South Africa, Tanzania and Zimbabwe

  • Applicants must be between the ages of 18 and 30 years at the time of application

  • Applicants must be currently enrolled at University level, in a tertiary course related to sustainability and the green economy. 

  • Applicants must have a minimum of 60% average (aggregate) from their latest results.

  • Applicants must have never flown or travelled outside of their country of birth

  • Applicants must have never flown or travelled outside of their country of birth. 

  • Applicants must be open to travelling both domestically and internationally. 

  • Applicants must not have a criminal record. 

  • Applicants must be available for the entirety of the program

  • Applicants must demonstrate that they come from previously disadvantaged background, as supported by an affidavit or letter from Traditional Authority.

  • Applicants must have access to a suitable device (tablet, phone, or computer) and reliable internet connectivity that will enable them to participate in the online trainings
